images.caption:
The shield-shaped plaque reads "Tolldy'r Gogledd, Northgate Toll House, c. 1785".

This toll house stands on the eastern side of the road just north of Aberaeron. It was a the start of the Aberaeron to Aberystwyth turnpike. It is now part of the A487 road.

Ceinewydd, Ceredigion had 1,082 inhabitants in the 2011 Census, 41% of whom spoke Welsh (down from 47% in 2001). The A486 connects it to Llandysul and Carmarthen. It stands halfway between Aberystwyth and Cardigan. (From cywiki)
